info.title: PromptHash Marketplace API
info.description:
Read-only marketplace API for PromptHash. The Soroban contract at `contracts/prompt-hash` is the single source of truth for prompt ownership, listing state, and purchase records. This server is a read-through cache, event indexer, and user-preference store; it never originates authoritative state changes.

Served by the backend at `GET /api/openapi.json`. An interactive explorer (Redoc) is available at `/api/docs`.

Generated as part of #713 so Stellar/PromptHash SDK consumers and integrators can validate requests against a machine-readable schema.

get.description: Reports indexer state and database backup health.

backup.description: Backup service health (empty object when disabled)

get.description: Returns all indexed prompt listings. On-chain state is authoritative.

parameters.name: contentHash
parameters.description: SHA-256 content hash of the prompt

get.summary: List prompts owned by a wallet
get.description: Indexed purchase records for a buyer wallet. Buyer identity is required to scope; the response never exposes other buyers.

get.summary: List prompts saved by a wallet
Purchase transaction history for a buyer
get.description: Pairs each on-chain purchase record with the prompt it unlocked.
Daily sales and revenue for the trailing 30-day window.
Conversion, refund, unlock-failure, and review outcomes for a creator's listings. Buyer identities are aggregated server-side and redacted; cohorts below the minimum are suppressed.
Sale-date, prompt, buyer address, gross/fee/net amounts. Supports `format=csv` or `Accept: text/csv` for CSV output.

get.summary: List prompt drafts for a creator
Current license terms for a prompt (#759)
get.description: Returns the license terms the prompt currently advertises. Falls back to the marketplace default when the creator has not configured one.

post.description: Creator-only. Material changes bump the prompt's `licenseVersionIndex`. Historical purchases are never mutated — they keep the immutable snapshot frozen at purchase time. Provide `templateKey` + `templateVersion` to adopt a template, or explicit terms fields for custom terms.

400.description: Invalid payload (missing fields, short terms text, template pair incomplete).

403.description: Caller is not the prompt owner.

get.description: Returns the active license templates creators can adopt for their prompts. Templates are versioned; only the latest active versions are listed.

get.summary: Buyer receipt with purchase-time license terms (#759)
get.description: Returns the buyer's receipt for a prompt, including the license snapshot frozen at purchase time. Legacy purchases (made before #759) report `license.legacy: true` and show the marketplace default terms. Response is wallet-scoped personal data (`Cache-Control: private, no-store`).

404.description: Purchase not found for this wallet.

get.description: Pairs the license snapshot frozen at purchase time with the prompt's current terms, so a dispute reviewer can see exactly what changed after the purchase. Requires an admin token with the `moderation:read` scope.

403.description: Admin token lacks the moderation:read scope.

post.description: Maintainer decision endpoint: approves or rejects a pending (queued) prompt. Only prompts with `moderationStatus: pending` can be overridden; decisions are appended to the ModerationReview history and the audit trail. Requires an admin token with the `moderation:write` scope.

200.description: Decision recorded and prompt status updated.

400.description: Invalid state machine transition or payload.

403.description: Admin token lacks the moderation:write scope.

get.description: Lists prompts queued by the heuristic safety scanner, or the review history for a single prompt when `promptId` is provided. Requires an admin token with the `moderation:read` scope. Hidden-payload fields are excluded from responses.

parameters.name: promptId
parameters.description: When present, returns the moderation review history for that prompt instead of the queue.

200.description: Moderation queue or per-prompt review history.

403.description: Admin token lacks the moderation:read scope.

post.description: Cancels a transfer previously requested by the caller. Requires a wallet signature.

post.summary: Approve or reject an ownership transfer
post.description: Recipient decision for a pending ownership transfer. Approval re-points the indexed Prompt.owner, affecting analytics and payout attribution. Requires a wallet signature.

404.description: Transfer not found or already resolved.

get.summary: List ownership transfers for a wallet
get.description: Returns pending and historical ownership-transfer handoffs where the wallet is sender or recipient (#708).

post.description: Starts the off-chain two-phase ownership handoff (#708). The current owner requests a transfer of an indexed prompt; the recipient approves or rejects. Requires a wallet signature.
Compares candidate prompt text against indexed prompts to detect near-duplicates before publishing. Off-chain advisory check; it does not gate on-chain publication.

200.description: Similarity report for the candidate prompt.

post.description: Records a preview view for analytics; non-authoritative.
Public — anyone can flag a listing. Off-chain moderation data only; does not affect on-chain access control.

evidence.description: Optional evidence attachments supporting the report (#714).

get.description: Requires an admin scope token (`reports:read`). Lists reports with triage state.

post.summary: Trigger a content integrity check (admin only)
post.description: Requires `integrity:write` admin scope. Body may include a `promptId` for a single prompt; otherwise a full sweep runs.
Wallet-signed preference. Does not change on-chain access.

post.summary: Submit or update a verified review
post.description: Requires ownership — the reviewer must have a purchase record for the prompt.

403.description: Reviewer does not own the prompt

get.summary: List reviews for a prompt with rating stats

post.description: Off-chain event delivery for indexed contract events (durable outbox).

post.summary: Rotate a webhook signing secret (admin only)

get.description: Advanced filtering and pagination over indexed listings.

post.description: Accepts raw webhook deliveries from external sources. Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature before processing. Idempotent — duplicate X-PromptHash-Event-Id values return 202 without reprocessing.

parameters.name: X-PromptHash-Event-Id
parameters.description: Stable idempotency key for this event

503.description: Inbound webhook intake is not configured

post.description: Resets a failed event to pending for reprocessing. Signature is NOT re-checked — only business logic reruns.

200.description: Event reset to pending for reprocessing

404.description: Not found or not in failed state

get.description: Returns filtered, paginated prompts for moderation review. Supports filtering by moderationStatus, similarityFlag, creatorWallet, and date range. Stale-query protection: all filters are applied server-side at query time.

post.description: Applies approve, reject, hide, or restore to a batch of selected prompts. Only eligible prompts (matching expected current state) are acted upon — ineligible ones are counted as skipped. Every decision is recorded in ModerationDecision with actor, reason, and timestamp. Rolls back by reversing the moderationStatus via /decisions/{id}/rollback.

400.description: Validation error — missing or invalid fields

post.description: Reverses a previous decision by restoring the prompt's prior moderationStatus and recording a rollback audit entry.

404.description: Decision not found or already rolled back

post.description: Anti-plagiarism semantic similarity check against the indexed prompt corpus.

get.summary: List ownership transfers for a wallet

post.summary: Respond to an ownership transfer request

adminToken.name: x-admin-token
adminToken.description: Admin scope token — e.g. `reports:read`, `integrity:write`. Returned by the admin login flow (#542).

version.description: Template version; new rows are appended, never edited.

licenseVersionIndex.description: Bumped on every material license change.

licenseCustomTerms.description: Creator-specific clauses layered onto the template.

walletAddress.description: Creator wallet; must own the prompt.

legacy.description: True for purchases made before #759; terms are the marketplace default.

snapshot.description: Frozen license snapshot (LicenseSnapshot document), or null for legacy purchases.

queue.description: Prompts with moderationStatus 'pending' (queued by the safety scanner).

history.description: Review history when promptId was provided.

reasonCode.description: false_positive / policy_exception / insufficient_evidence can only justify approve; policy_violation_confirmed can only justify reject.

SellerAnalytics.description: Privacy-safe seller metrics (#711). Buyer identities are never included.

ReportStatus.description: Triage lifecycle (#714): reports enter `pending`, move to `investigating` when an admin picks them up, then to `resolved` or `dismissed`.

rawHeaders.description: Non-sensitive request headers retained for debugging

action.description: Action to apply to all selected prompts

promptIds.description: MongoDB _id values of the prompts to act on

evidenceNote.description: Optional supporting evidence note stored with each decision

applied.description: Number of prompts successfully acted upon

actorWallet.description: SHA-256 hash of the admin wallet address

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid admin scope token
